Class Z85

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.delivery4j.util.Z85
public class Z85 extends Object
A Java implementation of the Z85 encoding scheme, based on the Z85 specification used by ZeroMQ, which is derivative of Ascii85 (and part of the Base85 family) encoding mechanism, but focused on source code usability.
This implementation contains the following types of encoding and decoding:
  • Default

    A Z85 encoding scheme that is almost the same as original Z85 specification, with key difference that mean to be used as a Base64 replacement. The encoder will add a ~ character for every remainder to mark an encoded non-4-length array. The decoder will read every ~ character to return the exact same array that was encoded.

  • Strict

    The original and restrictive Z85 encoding scheme without any change. The encoder will fail if provided array length is not a multiply of 4. The decoder will fail if provided String length is not a multiply of 5.

  • Padded

    A concise implementation that adds a padding for both array and String if the length does not meet Z85 scheme. The encoder will add empty bytes for arrays. The decoder will add '0' characters for Strings.

Unlike Base64, this specification doesn't contain a url-safe variant.
